elevation.$description: Confirmed via Figma variables (Drop shadow/*) and cross-checked against all 5 apps' Tailwind boxShadow config — already identical everywhere, no ratification conflict. Just needed one shared home.

xsmall.$description: Confirmed repeatedly via named 'Drop shadow/XSmall' variables: Input Field/Box (removed entirely in the Disabled state), and Button Group.

focus-ring.$description: Confirmed twice — Input Field/Box's Focused/Typing states, and again inside Table Content Cell's embedded input. A 4px solid-color ring, not a blurred shadow. Color (#E1E1FE) is close to but not identical to primary-100 (#E0E2FF), a small drift in the same shape as the brand-gold one. Only appears on the Box input style; the Line style changes only its border color on focus, no ring.

small.$description: Confirmed via the Stat component's named 'Drop shadow/Small' variable.

large.$description: Confirmed via the Tooltip component's named 'Drop shadow/Large' variable.

xlarge.$description: Confirmed twice — once via a named Figma variable, again via live design context on the Modal component (both Horizontal and Vertical alignment).
